:::{#def-fitting-procedure}
#### Fitting procedure

A **fitting procedure** is a rule $g$ that,
given any data $(x_1, y_1), \ldots, (x_n, y_n)$ and any covariate value $x$,
computes a [prediction](estimation.qmd#def-prediction) of the outcome at $x$:

$$
\paren{x; (x_1, y_1), \ldots, (x_n, y_n)}
\mapsto
g\paren{x; (x_1, y_1), \ldots, (x_n, y_n)}.
$$ {#eq-fitting-procedure}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
#### Source

The rule $g$ of the [definition of a prediction](estimation.qmd#def-prediction).
@hastie2009elements [sec. 7.2] write the model estimated from a training set as $\hat f$.
:::

:::
